name: expect_r6
title: Reports the matching check through the active test backend

origin.description: Reports the matching check through the active test backend. A failure stops with the check message.
origin.usage: expect_r6(x, classes = NULL, ordered = FALSE, cloneable = NULL, public = NULL, private = NULL, null.ok = FALSE, info = NULL, label = vname(x))

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Value under test. A Python int is an R integer and a Python float is an R double.

arguments.name: classes
arguments.text: Class names the object must inherit.

arguments.name: ordered
arguments.text: When true, the class names must appear in this order.

arguments.name: cloneable
arguments.text: When true the object must be cloneable, and when false it must not.

arguments.name: public
arguments.text: Names required in the public slots.

arguments.name: private
arguments.text: Names required in the private slots.

arguments.name: info
arguments.text: Extra text added when an expectation fails.

arguments.name: label
arguments.text: Name used in the expectation message.

origin.details: Reports the matching check through the active test backend. A failure stops with the check message.
origin.value: The value when the check passes. Otherwise the check stops.
origin.example:
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(checkmate))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(R6))
obj <- R6Class("Bar", public = list(a = 5))$new()
fn <- function(x) x
result <- expect_r6(obj, "Bar")
cat('R6\n')
